note: CONCEPTUAL PLACEHOLDER for the Universal Diagnostic Exam — one exam, taken at a level, testing four skills (Reading, Writing, Speaking, Comprehension) with mixed English/Arabic usage. Item types: mc (options + answer index, self-checkable), prompt (written response, teacher-scored), oral (spoken task, teacher-scored). Replace samples freely; scoring/administration stays with the teacher until a login tier exists.
intro: One exam, three levels. Each level samples the same four skills — reading, writing, speaking, and comprehension — with more Arabic and less English as the level rises. These are illustrative placeholder items.

Reading.q: Read the word: كَلْب — what does it mean?

Writing.q: Write the three letters of the Boat family (ب ت ث) in their separate forms.

Speaking.q: Say the alphabet from أ to خ aloud for your teacher.

Comprehension.q: Your teacher says: «اِفْتَح الكِتَاب». What should you do?

Reading.q: Read: أَنَا مِنْ العِرَاق — the speaker is saying…

Writing.q: Write one sentence in Arabic introducing yourself: your name and where you are from.

Speaking.q: Answer aloud in Arabic: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟

Comprehension.q: «ذَهَبَ الوَلَدُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَة» — Where did the boy go?

Reading.q: In «لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا الله», the word إِلَّا means…

Writing.q: اُكْتُب ثلاث جمل عن عائلتك (Write three sentences about your family, in Arabic).

Speaking.q: Recite Surah Al-Fatihah with tajweed, then explain one ayah in your own words.

Comprehension.q: Listen (teacher reads a short passage about الفُصُول الأربعة). Which season is described as «يَتَسَاقَطُ فِيهِ الثَّلْج»؟
